settings: kappa = 1/2 FITTED (cancels in the a0 ratio); footings 9.3603e-11 / 1.1312e-10 never pooled; candidate B; class A overdamped sink (CFG542 Pb); w_b = -1 background; cold energy mass required; no particle species; not theory closed

inherited: excursion-set turnaround-barrier mass fraction (PS / ST form), Gaussian ICs
Eisenstein-Hu linear spectrum (sigma8 0.811) and flat matter+Lambda linear growth (the PM's own input)
spherical-collapse t_reach with a Lambda term and the EPS main-progenitor history (cfg557_lib, PROVISIONAL)
DESI DR2 Gaussian sigmas (context only, from CFG549's committed JSON)

disclosures: s_c re-implements cfg557_lib.s_catch with the same iteration; only a converged 'nothing captured' state reads as 0 (CFG557 reports the 0.02 grid floor). alpha = 0 runs through the same code with t_cap = inf.

Post-first-run fixes (numbers in the first run differed only through these): (1) the first version made s_c = 0 ABSORBING at an intermediate iterate, which killed real fixed points (e.g. alpha 0.5, z 2, log M_ta 12: 0 instead of CFG557's 0.210); fixed to the CFG557 restart. (2) K2 first read 1.21e-9 (> 1e-9) because DOP853 stepped across the PCHIP knots; the ODE is now integrated knot to knot (9.8e-11). No criterion was changed.
eps_W uses CFG542's overdamped dW per catchment mass at FULL settling for every settled fraction; c_W spans 0.77-0.99 V_f^2 (+-13%).
U(t) is a state function of the halo population (re-settling after growth or mergers is not tracked separately); the ratchet keeps Q >= 0.
The background H(z) in the integration is the input matter+Lambda one; the feedback of a 1e-7 change on H is neglected.

f_ta (PS / ST on the turnaround barrier), the EH spectrum, linear growth, spherical-collapse t_reach and the EPS main progenitor are inherited ingredients; the result is labelled HMF context. DESI sigmas are context only.

sign.canonical_partner: regular only where its own 1 + w_phi >> q; the singular band is |1 + w| <~ q_max = 9.9e-07
